what: The Lean intake of OpenAI's Lean proof (GPT-6 Astra in Codex; openai/PrimeGaps186 at 61340d0b), conditional on three declared axioms against the release's own statement file, Challenge.lean: its first axiom, the rank-three Kloosterman bound, decided from the run's facts by tools/lean-intake.js (record format 2, instruments/intake/SPEC.md). CERTIFIED here says: the kernels named accept the claimant's proof as a proof of the canonical declaration's own statement; of the planted statements that reached the identity check, every one with a predicted outcome has it, at least one is refused and at least one rewording is accepted; the canonical hypotheses have a model; and every planted defect in the claimant's file is caught. A planted statement that did not elaborate tested nothing and is named, not counted. The spec was written by claimbox (python3 -m claimbox intake spec corpus/intake/pg186-ax1/target.json: every planted statement by a fixed rule, only certain outcomes predicted — "kernel decides" otherwise), copied here by LIFT-claimbox-intake.json and committed before the run.
notDecided: Whether the canonical statement is the informal problem (a reading, F5; F2, instance agreement, was not run). Kernels THIS RUN did not run: leanchecker-paranoid, lean4lean, con-leche, con-ron — another record of the same proof may have run them; this record speaks for its own run only.
